replies.author: _Nathy
replies.body:
If you want to know why Blaze was kicked, please come to me on teamspeak or skype @nathanpatricbrown cause I don't want to call people out on the forums.


In short, Blaze was planning to leave Cacal soon, then there was an altercation on Teamspeak which was not Blaze's fault - he was caught in the crossfire, however I was ticked off at what he did.

Apart from that:

HUGE VOUCH - This guy can play offensively and defensively extremely well. Despite having shit ping he can fight with the bow and sword extremely well. You might have to remind him he has a mic and tell him to use his words once in a while but apart from that he'd be a great addition to any team
